story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.hive_5: Be careful. A number of fighters from the joint force have slipped into the geofront. They may be waiting for you here. Your current objective is to find a special device and install the Andreev Emitter into it.
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.hive_6: This is what we need. The nuclear warhead can disperse Earth's anti-quasimorph field across the entire Solar System. To do that, however, you must amplify the ionizing front with a special pulse. The Andreev Emitter can generate it. Return here with the device and install it on the bomb.
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.hive_7: Excellent. Install the Andreev Emitter on the nuclear warhead. The explosion, amplified by a special pulse, will disperse Earth's anti-quasimorph field across the entire Solar System.
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.hive_8: Thank you for your excellent work, clone. Unfortunately, there is no time for evacuation. I am activating the nuclear network immediately. Farewell.
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.jane_1: Earth... Beautiful if you're writing a will. I prefer space. There's nothing for you to do on the surface. Find the entrance to the bunk...
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.jane_2: Great, you found the bunker entrance. Descend... ...tter... ...ppen... Comm...
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.jane_3: Something strange is happening to the Magnum. Looks like someone hacked us. I'll try to identify the source of the malicious signa...
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.jane_4: The Magnum's systems are failing one by one. Our analysts and pilots are trying to determine the cause. The cubecentric engine is showing an abnormal energy spike. We have to preven...
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.jane_5: Comms are back, but... Continue the contract, and I'll give you the really bad news. There has been a series of explosions aboard the Magnum. We are completely immobilized. Someone accessed our systems and overloaded them. We'll try to find out what can be done. We're hoping for the Hive's assistance. The shuttle survived, so you can still count on evacuation.
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.jane_6:
Listen to me. I'm sending a shuttle for you. Stay close to the extraction point. We found what caused the explosion on the Magnum. Remember the AnCom secret data we recovered on Phobos? I copied it before we handed it over. Don't ask why—old habits. There was a Trojan inside. A backdoor into the Magnum's firmware. It was waiting for an external signal to overload the ship's firmware.

One second, I'm tracing the signal source... No. It was the Hive.
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.sseth_1:
Hey, hey, salvage nation! Kill this bastard. The Hive really is trying to activate the warhead and blow Earth apart from the inside.

And you, clone, listen carefully. What's down there is not a "transformation device." It's a bomb. And it's buried so deep that even RealWare would call it bad taste.
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.sseth_2: Don't you understand they're keeping you in the dark again? The only reason I brought my space folk here was to give you time to understand—sometimes it's better to stay in the sandbox.
story.hiv_3_awakened.name: The Hive Awakens
story.hiv_3_awakened.objective.activate_: Activate the Geofront Masts on the Second Level.
story.hiv_3_awakened.objective.install_e: Install the Andreev Emitter into the device on the geofront level.
story.hiv_3_awakened.stage1.name: Bunker Outskirts
story.hiv_3_awakened.stage2.name: AnCom Bunker
story.hiv_3_awakened.stage3.name: Geofront
story.hiv_3_awakened.stage4.name: AnCom Sanctuary
story.hiv_space.dlg.finale: Look carefully. That was <color=#FFFEC1>Earth</color>. But salvation did not happen, and the fault is mine alone. We have only a few minutes left. Now I can tell the truth.
story.hiv_space.dlg.hive1:
AnCom is gone. After the loss of the Unveiled, execution of the Master Plan is no longer possible. The true name of the catastrophe is Gagtungr. He is ready to emerge from the very structure of reality. The only way to save humanity is to abandon the salvation of the multitude. The multitude will always begin another war, no matter what we teach it or how. We do not have time for moral education. A new unity is the true ark of humanity. To prepare the special event on Earth capable of preventing Gagtungr’s emergence, three operations must be carried out. We will neutralize those who can interfere with the Hive. You have three contracts:

Attack the Vasa station on Geist to show humanity the true face of Dilthey.

Carry out the operation to integrate SBN into the Hive by attacking the ISS AES station in Earth orbit.

Finally, liberate the AnCap system from its oppressors by destroying the leadership of RealWare. Carry out a lightning strike against the HIS Ares in Mars orbit.

We will always be nearby. We will coordinate your attacks so that you may see the power the Hellstrom Network grants when placed in the proper hands. Choose the most obedient clones, so that the objectives are completed with maximum—even mechanical—efficiency.

When all three tasks are complete, the time will come for truly decisive action.
story.hiv_space.dlg.hive2:
Preparation for the final stage is complete. The main decision-making systems have been integrated into the Hive, and the key competitors have been neutralized. The salvation of humanity now appears possible. All that remains is to activate the mechanism of salvation itself.

And this is where we will need your services again, mercenary. At this very moment, a handful of minor corporations, led by desperate cutthroats from the Unchained Belt, have seized an old AnCom facility on the Orkney Islands. Yes, on Earth.

The problem is that the mechanism capable of cleansing the inhabited System of quasimorphosis is located there. How did they obtain this information? Who did you provide with AnCom secret data? The time has come for final atonement.

Beneath the bunker lies the geofront—a system of tunnels descending toward the Earth’s core. The device required to complete the transformation is located there. Deliver the Andreev Emitter to the device and launch the procedure.
story.rwa_1_covert.after: Even the <color=#FFFEC1>hexarchs</color> are ready to tear out each other's throats and plunge their hands into other people's business. It seems that there is more and more work for us. The <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare reward</color> has been delivered.
story.rwa_1_covert.briefing: You won't believe it, but the mission may be easier than we thought. The geoscanner detected an <color=#FFFEC1>unusual field</color> around the station. AnCom installed morphoprotectors, so the Citadel should not have <color=#FFFEC1>quasimorphosis</color>. Get into the data center, activate the <color=#FFFEC1>EMP-Scorcher</color>, and we'll be ready to pick you up.
story.rwa_1_covert.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Activate the <color=#FFFEC1>EMP-Scorcher</color> in the station's data center.
story.rwa_1_covert.details:
Details: AnCom is planning operations using the RealWare combat AI. This asset is not for sale, so RealWare suspects AnCom of theft. Our task: destroy all AnCom data on the combat AI.

Additional Info: Humankinds's Hope Citadel was the headquarters of the Hive Corporation. It could well have claimed the role of hexarch, but it ceased to exist in the mid-22nd century. It is not surprising that AnCom decided to organize field research here. On the one hand, the Citadel is considered a fairly useless asset. On the other hand, the station is well protected.

The latter means that there are no single-shaft elevators there. Most likely, you will have to deal with a confusing system of stairs and long galleries, in which AnCom will have time to organize a defense.
story.rwa_1_covert.dlg.ancom_entering_da: Attention, station personnel! <color=#FFFEC1>Morphoprotection<color=#FFFEC1> is disabled. Everyone, apply counter-quasimorphic measures.
story.rwa_1_covert.dlg.ancom_entering_li: This is AnCom speaking. We demand that the clone be recalled immediately, otherwise we will be forced to take <color=#FFFEC1>emergency measures</color>. The demand will not be repeated.
story.rwa_1_covert.dlg.jane_emp_activate: The <color=#FFFEC1>EMP-Scorcher</color> has been activated. Looks like all the computers on the station are now dead. If AnCom doesn't have backups, we've pretty much knocked them back. Mission accomplished. Get out of there... And your equipment is fried, too, the <color=#FFFEC1>map is inaccessible</color>. You'll have to go in blind.
story.rwa_1_covert.dlg.jane_entering_dat: Turns out it's not as easy as we thought. You should hurry!
story.rwa_1_covert.dlg.jane_on_arrival: The station is very old. Most levels are connected by stairs. Elevators can help you shorten the way to the data center, but rest assured, <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> will take care of the elevator exits first.
story.rwa_1_covert.dlg.jane_target_room: Great, you're in position. Set up the <color=#FFFEC1>EMP-Scorcher</color> near the computers.
story.rwa_1_covert.dlg.jane_target_room_: Wait, you don't have the <color=#FFFEC1>EMP-Scorcher</color>! Without it, we can't disable the station's systems. You need to go back and find the device, or the mission will fail.
story.rwa_1_covert.dlg.realware_after_an:
Greetings, mercenary! Some time ago, you gave us some very interesting information about AnCom. I believe that you chose us for a reason. RealWare is the only corporation that guards the interests of the AnCap system. We are its true defenders.

It turns out that AnCom has made great strides in quasimorphic research. According to information from the PCPU, we are not even talking about decades of research there. To delve so deeply into quasimorphosis, one would have to start long before the Great Anarchic Revolution. Now I understand why Doctor Manning is considered a genius. He had a very good start.

We’ve given you the data needed to hack a PCPU. Perform any Espionage mission for AnCom, hack their device, and we'll get into their closed network. Let's find out what AnCom really is.
story.rwa_1_covert.dlg.realware_after_es:
Good job! The hacked PCPU is transmitting data to us from the closed AnCom network. It will take several months to sort out the data. But we already see a direct threat to order in the Solar System. AnCom is trying to hack the algorithm of the RealWare corporation’s combat AI. Our combat AI.

We don’t yet know why and how they want to use it, but we can’t allow it. The AnCom analytical center, which collects information about the AI, is located at the Humankinds's Hope Citadel on the Pallas asteroid. We offer you a contract: get to the station’s data center and activate the EMP-Scorcher there. We've transferred it to your spacecraft. And check how it works at the same time.

AnCom's property will not be harmed, and if they try to accuse someone of damaging the data, they will have to say what kind of data it was. They will not do that.
story.rwa_1_covert.name: Covert Operations Guide
story.rwa_1_covert.objective0: You need to get to the <color=#FFFEC1>station data center</color> and activate the <color=#FFFEC1>EMP-Scorcher</color>.
story.rwa_1_covert.objective1: <color=#FFFEC1>Mission accomplished</color>, the data center is now a pile of junk.
story.rwa_1_covert.stage1.name: Landing Zone
story.rwa_1_covert.stage2.name: Control Room
story.rwa_1_covert.stage3.name: Residential Area
story.rwa_1_covert.stage4.name: Data Center
story.rwa_2_malefic.after: Boss, all across the Solar System, <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> is taking control of stations held by the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>. But that’s not even the biggest news. The <color=#FFFEC1>HIS Invincible</color> has carried out a nuclear strike on the asteroid <color=#FFFEC1>Hecate</color>. Nothing is left of the asteroid. This is the first publicly acknowledged use of nuclear weapons since the <color=#FFFEC1>Great Anarchist Revolution</color>. On <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color>, corporate spokespeople claimed that a secret <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> base was located on <color=#FFFEC1>Hecate</color>. I get it, boss: contracts, security, stability, a chance for someone like you to find a place in this chaos. But doesn't it seem like <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> is already acting as if the entire ancap system belongs to them?
story.rwa_2_malefic.briefing:
We'll drop you near the base. After that, you're on your own. Find a way inside. The central computer is hidden somewhere on the lower levels, and getting to it won't be easy.

There's a real chance that today marks the end of the Civil Resistance's century-long history—and you'll be the one to end it.
story.rwa_2_malefic.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find a way to destroy the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>.
story.rwa_2_malefic.details:
Details: RealWare is launching a series of operations to save the AnCap system from total collapse. They have shared limited projections from their combat AI. While the machine searches for a way to destroy Tezctlan, we are to carry out preemptive strikes against the forces of the Unchained Belt and the Civil Resistance.
The Civil Resistance is fractured by internal struggle. Several factions are fighting for control of the movement, and one of its most dangerous commanders, Issachar, has taken over operational planning in the Inner System. To coordinate his colnodes through the Hellstrom Network, he built a dedicated server and transferred part of his consciousness into it. This allows him to maintain control with maximum efficiency.
Currently, this coordination node is too far away, on Vesta. But Issachar has already begun preparations to relocate it to one of Mars's moons. According to RealWare's combat AI projections, this is the ideal moment to strike. The colnodes are preoccupied with the move, the channels are overloaded, and the control system itself is more vulnerable than usual.
Our task: infiltrate the facility, reach the server, and destroy Issachar. Once the coordinating center falls, his entire network will begin to collapse on its own.

Additional: The target is not in the Carmel mining colony itself, but at a nearby military base. On paper, the base still belongs to its former owner, but RealWare corporate intelligence has confirmed that the facility was taken over long ago by Civil Resistance militants.
The base is prepared for defense and equipped with anti-spacecraft guns, among other things. For this reason, the shuttle carrying the operator will be deployed from a significant distance. The good news is that the colnodes are currently distracted by relocation preparations and should be unprepared for our arrival. The strike has to be fast. While Issachar is busy evacuating, we have a chance to decapitate the entire system with one precise hit.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.angus_stage1_1st: Here are the keys. The data structure shows that <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chips</color> grant access to Issachar's central computer. But one is not enough. Standard entry into the system requires three keys. Our satellite scans show that all of them are on this level. Continue the sweep, recover the remaining chips, then head upstairs via the staircase.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.angus_stage1_2nd: Excellent, mercenary! Issachar's second key colnode is destroyed. Don't forget to pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color>. You'll need the full set for standard system access.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.angus_stage1_3rd: Excellent, good work. Grab the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> and head for the staircase to the second level. You now have the full set required to connect to Issachar's consciousness.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.angus_stage1_gre: According to our estimates, resistance will be moderate. For you, however, even that is enough. Do not bring the <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color> close to the base, even if you want to use the geoscanner or count the signatures. Our spy satellite is operating nearby, we will provide you with all the necessary information. First of all, it is clear that destroying the server itself won't do any good. <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> will simply transfer his consciousness to another part of the network. To eliminate him, you will have to enter the system and destroy his consciousness from the inside. Look for the access keys—without them, the operative clone will not be able to get inside.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.angus_stage4_gj: Signal restored. We are detecting the collapse of the <color=#FFFEC1>Hellstrom Networks</color> across the Solar System. The operation can be considered a success. RealWare Security is now at combat readiness. Permission granted to evacuate the operator.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.issach_stage3_wa: You don't even notice how willingly you go where you are led. Have you even tried asking questions? I placed the key in your hands only because I wanted to meet the mindless enforcer face to face. Come here and let's see what remains of you when I consume what you call a soul.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.issach_stage4_wa: You are alone. Hear that? No voices on the comms, no orders, no kind capitalists behind your back. It is just you and me here. They threw you inside like a tool, and then left you to figure things out on your own. Let's see if you are capable of being something more than an instrument of someone else's will.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.issachar_stage2_: Do you really not understand who you serve? RealWare buys your ability to kill obediently, and you dutifully walk the line drawn for you by a soulless machine. We are not the network, mercenary. The network is them. A market of oppression, poisoning humanity. Turn back before it’s too late, or be destroyed.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.jane_stage1_1st_: There is a shortcut. Disable the anti-ship guns, and the pilots will be able to bring the <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color> to the base's docking airlock. From here I can connect to the central computer. I think one <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> will be quite enough for me.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.jane_stage1_bloc: Beyond this elevator is an airlock for docking heavy interplanetary ships. But as long as the base's anti-ship defenses are active, bringing the <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color> in is too dangerous. Disable the defenses first, and then you will be able to go up.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.jane_stage1_open: The pilots are already bringing the Magnum in to dock with the base. Take the elevator up to the docking airlock and make your way to the ship. A single Red Chip will be enough for you to access Issachar's computer.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.jane_stage2_orde: Once all three Red Chips are inserted into the server, your consciousness will be projected into Issachar's hallucinatory-digital system. We are not sure if we will have contact with you in there. Your task will be to find Issachar's central psychological projection and destroy it. RealWare's combat AI is trying to hack the system and help you with virtual implants and weapons. We will do what we can. Good luck.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.jane_stage3_dock: The Magnum has docked with the base, and we are already connected to the system. Now we only need the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color>. The ship's internal bulkheads are sealed — the colnodes shouldn't be able to get to us. Only the docking bay will be accessible to you.
story.rwa_2_malefic.dlg.jane_stage3_magn: Welcome back to the <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color>. Almost nothing has changed here since you flew out. All right, enough kidding around. Insert the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> into the terminal, and we will try to project your consciousness inside <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar's</color> system. With the help of the RealWare combat AI, we have analyzed the hallucinatory digital reality deeply enough and will be able to help you with virtual implants and weapons. Your task will be to find the central psychological projection of Issachar and destroy it. Good luck.
story.rwa_2_malefic.name: Malleus Maleficarum
story.rwa_2_malefic.objective0: Enter the Civil Resistance central server.
story.rwa_2_malefic.objective1: You need to take the shuttle back to the Magnum. Evacuate as usual.
story.rwa_2_malefic.stage1.name: CR Base Entrance
story.rwa_2_malefic.stage2.name: Control Center
story.rwa_2_malefic.stage3.name: Docking Airlock
story.rwa_2_malefic.stage4.name: Issachar's Consciousness
story.rwa_2_treasure.after: Boss, looks like someone else had a plan too. While we were coordinating the removal of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> leadership, <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color> moved to seize every asset the pirates had been holding across the Solar System. <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> only got <color=#FFFEC1>Hargeysa</color>. Then again, it seems <color=#FFFEC1>Angus Dungeon</color> wanted it for some reason. Either way, the AnCap system just lost one major source of chaos.
story.rwa_2_treasure.briefing: We'll drop you on an old service level. According to RealWare’s intel, the pirates consider it a dead level and keep no guards there. Take a moment to look around and think through your approach. As soon as you move higher, they'll raise the alarm. The main elevator shaft runs through the entire station. The pirate admiral is on the fifth floor. Reach him and kill him.
story.rwa_2_treasure.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the admiral of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color>.
story.rwa_2_treasure.details:
Details: RealWare is launching a series of operations to save the AnCap system from total collapse. They have provided us with limited projections from their combat AI. While the machine searches for a way to destroy Tezctlan, we are to carry out preemptive strikes against the forces of the Civil Resistance and the Unchained Belt.
The Unchained Belt unites hundreds of pirate crews held together not by discipline, but by profit, mutual aid, and faith in what they call true anarchy. RealWare's combat AI proposes a simple move. If you destroy the coordinating center, the entire alliance will begin to fall apart on its own. That's it—no subtle politics, just a precise and brutal strike at the backbone holding the entire structure together.
We are not expecting unusual complications from this mission. On the contrary, surprise will be our greatest weapon. The Main Belt still has not realized that RealWare intends to act openly and decisively. The very act of breaking the old status quo is already working in our favor.

Additional: Hargeysa Station draws power from an old nuclear reactor. The reconnaissance data passed to us by RealWare indicates that it is stable, but caution may be required on the control level.
